info.description: The API the Retune console uses. Sign in with a session (the retune_session cookie, with the X-CSRF-Token header on every change) or send an API token as `Authorization: Bearer rtk_…`. Each operation's `x-retune-access` names who may call it. Errors are `{"code": "…", "message": "…"}`.
